summary: Explosions were reported in Bushehr and Chabahar, Iran, with conflicting claims about causes and responsibility. The Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) conducted operations in Gaza, targeting a senior Hamas military production commander, and intercepted a suspected kidnapping incident in the West Bank. US military strikes targeted Iranian military infrastructure near Hormuz, according to Iranian state media, while the IRGC launched missiles from western Iran. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375856) (Source: @idf_telegram/24586) (Source: @VahidOnline/76899)
key_points: Explosions were reported in Bushehr and Chabahar, Iran, with Iranian officials investigating whether they resulted from air defenses or hostile projectiles. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375856)
The IDF killed Ridha al-Ekkahtsi, a senior Hamas military production commander, in Gaza, and Abdelrahman al-Din Razak al-Suti, a military operative, in northern Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24586)

US military strikes targeted over 170 Iranian military objectives near Hormuz, including air defense systems, missile depots, and naval infrastructure, according to Iranian reports. (Source: @VahidOnline/76899)
IRGC launched two missiles from Al Mahdi Base in Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, toward unspecified targets. (Source: @shin_persian/7604)
A suspected kidnapping of an IDF servicewoman in Gush Etzion was resolved as a domestic incident involving a Palestinian man and the soldier. (Source: @yediotnews25/132484)
Iranian state media reported explosions in Bushehr, Chabahar, and other cities, while the IRGC claimed US strikes disrupted maritime traffic in Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/76905)
The IRGC stated it would respond forcefully to US military actions and criticized GCC countries for alleged joint military operations against Iran. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75389)
Israeli officials emphasized readiness to respond to threats from Iran and Lebanon, with the IDF monitoring regional developments closely. (Source: @yediotnews25/132494)
